categories.main_business_segments: Kangping Technology primarily engages in the research, design, production, and sales of motors, electric tool assemblies, precision hardware parts, plastic parts, and battery packs. The company is transitioning from motor manufacturing towards electric tool assembly manufacturing, with electric tool assemblies now accounting for nearly 40% of sales. It also develops electric-assisted bicycles and related products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core motor manufacturing technologies including winding, spot welding, varnishing, dynamic balancing, precision machining, and automated inspection. It applies advanced equipment and strict quality control systems (ISO9001, IATF16949 certified). Kangping also emphasizes in-house manufacturing of key components and integrates supply chain management to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Kangping serves leading global electric tool brands such as Black & Decker (Stanley Black & Decker), TTI Group, Metabo, Bosch, Hilti, and Makita. Its products are widely used in construction, woodworking, metalworking, shipbuilding, aerospace, automotive, and gardening industries. The company is also expanding into automotive and home appliance sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with production bases in China (Suzhou), Vietnam, South Korea, and Hong Kong. Its main markets are international, with approximately 90% of sales being exports, primarily to North America and Europe, which together account for about 80% of the global electric tool market.
categories.supply_chain_position: Kangping operates mainly as a midstream manufacturer and supplier in the electric tool industry, producing motors and electric tool assemblies. It supplies key components and finished assemblies to major brand owners, supporting their product development and manufacturing needs. The company also extends upstream into raw material procurement and downstream into assembly and supply chain management.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on enhancing motor performance, expanding product categories, and optimizing supply chain and production capabilities. It invests heavily in R&D, with over 40 million RMB spent in 2024, developing brushless motors, low-vibration motors, high-torque motors, and specialized motors for automotive and garden tools. Kangping emphasizes talent development, digital transformation, and lean manufacturing to improve efficiency and innovation.
categories.revenue_model: Kangping generates revenue primarily through product sales of motors, electric tool assemblies, and related components. The majority of sales are direct exports to major international customers. The company also earns income from investment returns and government subsidies but these are minor compared to product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a mature global electric tool market dominated by multinational corporations like Black & Decker, TTI, Bosch, Makita, Hilti, and Metabo. Kangping positions itself as a large-scale, high-quality motor and electric tool assembly manufacturer with strong supply chain integration and R&D capabilities, steadily increasing its market share and influence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Kangping reported revenues of approximately 1.16 billion RMB, a 24.19% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of about 85 million RMB, up 71.45%. The company has grown steadily with expanding production capacity exceeding 20 million units annually. It maintains a healthy cash flow and continues to invest in capacity expansion and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Kangping emphasizes its global supply chain layout, advanced manufacturing technologies, and comprehensive quality control to deliver reliable, high-performance motors and electric tool assemblies. Its ability to rapidly respond to customer needs through collaborative R&D and customized solutions, combined with scale advantages and stable relationships with top-tier customers, differentiates it in the competitive electric tool industry.
